data.title: Identifying Angle Relationships
data.description: Practice recognizing and naming complementary, supplementary, vertical, and adjacent angle pairs in various geometric figures.

challenges.narration: Roof rafters form this pair of angles.
challenges.instruction: Look at how the two angles meet. What is their relationship?
challenges.hint: Do the outer rays make a straight line (180°), a right angle (90°), or do two lines cross? Equal opposite angles are vertical.
